proved: Reuses gkrFiniteCircuit with exact composition across finite layer boundaries.
Output-to-input GKR values are computed by evaluating finite prefixes from one input assignment.
Every in-range actual layer entry agrees with gkrLayerValues of the next depth and fixed wiring.
Recovered private slots plus known constants define the input; the terminal depth returns that input by construction.
The final GKR mismatch equals the full recovered input mismatch without a caller-supplied assignment-equality premise.
indexing: Reverse depth0 is the complete circuit output; depth=layers.length is the input. A GKR strategy reducing the output layer uses depth1 for its input values. The terminal adapter requires depth+preceding_round_count=layers.length.
explicit_limits: Step equality is for in-range gate indices; padded layer/cube shape correspondence remains an implementation obligation.
No claim that executable AIR compilation produced these finite layers, or that an arbitrary verifier strategy is bound to their values.
Decoded source commitment binding, layered-path/selected-coordinate sampling alignment, global AIR/bus/Wasm soundness and quantum transcript reduction remain open.
